source: NASA PCoE Li-ion Battery Aging Dataset

reference_capacity_decision.current_soh_definition: 100 * measured discharge Capacity / median of the first 10 valid positive discharge capacities per battery

nominal_capacity_evidence.meaning: A documented rated-capacity denominator for a nominal-capacity ratio, not a cell-specific measured reference-performance result. Its use as SOH for each battery requires matching the capacity test conditions to the rated-capacity protocol.

reference_capacity_decision.other_reference_evidence: README1.txt states a 2 Ah rated capacity for B0005, B0006, B0007, and B0018 and says their EOL threshold is 1.4 Ah. Other group READMEs include 1.6 Ah/20% fade EOL statements, so local experimental endpoints are not uniform.
reference_capacity_decision.reason: No available record designates a particular measured discharge as a reference-performance test for each cell. The first-ten-positive median is an undocumented heuristic, and raw cycles include documented protocol differences and unresolved low or internally inconsistent capacity records.

official_page_states: Capacity experiments span distinct current loads, voltage cutoffs, and temperatures.
Some cutoff voltages are below the OEM-recommended 2.7 V.
Dataset-level rated capacity is described as 2 Ah, with general EOL at 1.4 Ah (30% fade).
The MATLAB Capacity field is described as Ah for discharge to 2.7 V.
The intended use emphasizes run-to-failure prognostics and notes differing DOD, rest duration, and intrinsic variability.

local_readme_conflicts.finding: These group READMEs state EOL at 1.6 Ah (20% fade), not the official page's general 1.4 Ah/30% description.
Each describes the Capacity field as Ah to 2.7 V, while cell-specific experimental cutoffs range from 2.0 V to 2.7 V.
Explicitly states that several capacities are very low and their reasons have not been fully analyzed.

raw_data_reconciliation.review_threshold_note: The 0.5 Ah and 2.0 Ah cutoffs are inherited non-scientific triage flags, not exclusion rules. All positive values and source cycle provenance are retained in this report.

required_evidence: A documented cell-specific reference-capacity rule or measured reference-performance cycle under a defined protocol.
Clarification of whether low capacities represent partial tests, current/profile effects, data-acquisition artifacts, or valid measurements.
Reconciliation of each cell's actual voltage cutoff with the common 2.7 V Capacity-field description.
Resolution of conflicting group EOL capacities and confirmation whether 2 Ah applies as an individual-cell rated baseline.
A prediction-time feature contract that excludes target capacity and same-discharge measurement proxies unavailable at prediction time.

trace_diagnostic_caveat: The included absolute-current trapezoid integral is calculated from sparsely sampled raw current/time vectors only as a consistency diagnostic. It is not a capacity reference, not an independent capacity measurement, and not a basis for correcting or excluding a capacity value.
